found_by: following shape C down to reading two component lists side by side, after four aggregate hypotheses failed
the_defect: damage_component_events attributes direct move damage to a HEAL source. Observed on s18000869/18 as observed=[('', -137)] against a matching branch decomposed as [('itemleftovers', -134)], and on s18001093/100 as [('', -160)] against [('itemleftovers', -153)]. Leftovers is a heal of maxhp/16 -- roughly 20 HP at most, and always positive. A Leftovers tick of -134 is not a wrong number, it is an impossible one.
why_it_costs_rows: The matcher compares component SOURCE and magnitude. A branch whose HP outcome is correct but whose damage is labelled itemleftovers fails on source identity and is rejected. The row is then reported divergent even though the engine reproduced the transition.

measurement_with_control.method: scanned every branch decomposition for a heal-source component with a negative delta

this_failure_class_is_already_documented: damage_component_events' own docstring records it for Pain Split: 'the instrument reported impossible components such as a Leftovers heal of -73 and blamed the engine for them (seed 1500008 step 101: true Leftovers +13/+25, harness said +9/+28, engine said +13/+25 -- the engine was right)'. That fix consumed -sethp. The same folding is happening again through a different path, so the earlier repair was specific to Pain Split rather than general.

the_ceiling_and_why_i_am_stating_it.why: 79 rows HAVE such a branch. It does not follow that repairing the attribution clears them: a row can still diverge for an unrelated reason on another slot or component. This is the same per-slot-versus-whole-boundary distinction that produced two withdrawn claims earlier in this shape, and I am marking the ceiling before anyone reads 79 as a predicted delta.

why_this_is_registrable_when_the_earlier: It has a named mechanism, a physically impossible signature that cannot be a matter of degree, a 21x enrichment against a matched control, and a bounded candidate population. It is also an INSTRUMENT fix, so it needs no engine rebuild and no fingerprint change, which means it cannot void the era-stamped adjudications.
next: find where damage_component_events folds a damage delta onto a heal source -- the Pain Split precedent says a missing or misread event line lets the next delta inherit the previous source -- then register a prediction with identity-level falsifiers over the 79.
